features: Soundbar with Wireless Subwoofer: Experience 100 Watts of powerful sound with two full-range drivers and a wireless subwoofer delivering deep, thumping bass without the clutter of cables
2.1 Channel Home Theater with Remote(AAA Battery x 2): The Philips Soundbar brings the theater experience to your home with 2.1 Channel, enhancing the immersive feeling in movies and music

Multipoint Connectivity & Flexible Music Streaming: Enjoy versatile setup options with HDMI ARC and optical connections for easy user accessibility and stream music from your mobile or tablet via Bluetooth
Remote Control for voice clarity: Use the dedicated voice mode on the remote control to enhance voice clarity, making dialogues stand out against background noise
Sleek Design: The Soundbar’s sleek design, fits neatly under your TV and complements any home environment without blocking the TV’s bottom edge
